entities.summary: Princess Maria-Pia of Liechtenstein, also known as Maria-Pia Kothbauer, is Liechtensteiner diplomat and a member of the Princely family of Liechtenstein. She serves as the Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of Liechtenstein to Austria and the Czech Republic, formerly also to Belgium and the European Union. She also serves as Liechtenstein's Permanent Representative to the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe and to the United Nations.
